protocol.aggregation_choice: higher validation 8-way accuracy; ties go to argmax
protocol.threshold_choice: largest validation coverage whose one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound on selective risk (8-way routing error among kept rows) is <= the target; no such threshold means every query goes to the LLM
protocol.signal_choice: largest validation coverage at the target, then lower validation AURC
protocol.oracle: defers exactly the queries the small model gets wrong (8-way)
protocol.oos_detection_score: 1 - max in-scope probability at the fitted T (151 intents for argmax, 8 agents for summed); the four confidence signals are for RQ3
protocol.threshold_result: main result: thresholds chosen on validation only, reported as they do on test (option a); diagnostics.sensitivity_reweighted_validation is option (b), diagnosis only
protocol.tie_at_tau: a row whose confidence equals tau is kept by the small model
protocol.error_recovery_rate: small-model errors deferred and fixed by Haiku / small errors
protocol.recoverable_caught: errors deferred and fixed by Haiku / errors Haiku would fix
protocol.high_conf_oos_misroute_rate: gold OOS kept by the small model (confidence >= tau) and routed to an in-scope agent / gold OOS
protocol.operating_curve_tau: the validation score at each coverage of the grid
protocol.std: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over seeds 42, 43, 44; no other randomness

llm_only_test.note: no confidence score, so no high-confidence misroute; see oos_misroute_rate
